Independence Day with Nipun
2020-03-24T00:00:00+06:00 | The Daily Star
https://www.thedailystar.net/lifestyle/news/independence-day-nipun-1884973

In the hearts of every Bangladeshi, the month of March is synonymous with the spirit of independence. To honour this spirit, fashion house Nipun is set once again with a collection to uphold all that is free and proud. Nipun is offering shalwar-kameez, sari, panjabi and baby dresses this time around, without breaking the bank. This new collection can be found at all Nipun outlets. For more information, visit www.facebook.com/nipuncraft
